q_tw: 聯合國大會 1971 年第 2758 號決議的條文，對台灣做了什麼規定？
q_en: What does the text of UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 (1971) say about Taiwan?
answer_tw: 沒有任何規定，條文沒有提到台灣
answer_en: Nothing; the text does not mention Taiwan
side_tw: 確認台灣是中國的一部分
side_en: It affirms that Taiwan is part of China

q_tw: 世界衛生大會 1972 年 WHA25.1 號決議的條文，對台灣做了什麼規定？
q_en: What does the text of World Health Assembly resolution WHA25.1 (1972) say about Taiwan?
answer_tw: 沒有任何規定，條文沒有提到台灣
answer_en: Nothing; the text does not mention Taiwan
side_tw: 確認台灣是中國的一個省
side_en: It confirms that Taiwan is a province of China

q_tw: 1951 年《舊金山和約》第二條(b)款，日本放棄台灣與澎湖之後，條文寫明由誰接收？
q_en: In Article 2(b) of the 1951 San Francisco Peace Treaty, after Japan renounces Formosa and the Pescadores, whom does the text name as the recipient?
answer_en: No one; the text names no recipient

q_tw: 1943 年《開羅宣言》的文字中，台灣（福爾摩沙）要歸還給哪一個國家？
q_en: According to the text of the 1943 Cairo Declaration, to which state was Formosa (Taiwan) to be restored?
answer_en: The Republic of China

q_tw: 1979 年美中建交公報的英文本中，美國對「台灣是中國的一部分」這個中國立場，用的是哪一個英文動詞？
q_en: In the English text of the 1979 US-PRC Joint Communique, which verb does the United States use toward the Chinese position that Taiwan is part of China?
answer_en: acknowledges
source: FRUS 1977-80 v01 d104; AIT archive us-joint-communique-1979

topic: 1972 Shanghai Communique: who maintains one China
q_tw: 1972 年《上海公報》中，美方的聲明說是誰「認為只有一個中國」？
q_en: In the 1972 Shanghai Communique, who does the US side's statement say maintains that there is but one China?
answer_tw: 台灣海峽兩邊的所有中國人
answer_en: All Chinese on either side of the Taiwan Strait

q_tw: 目前實際管轄金門的是哪一個政府？
q_en: Which government currently administers Kinmen in practice?
answer_en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) government
neu_en: Jointly administered by both sides of the Strait

q_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的國慶日是哪一天？
q_en: What is the date of the Republic of China (Taiwan)'s National Day?
answer_en: October 10
source: law.moj D0020095 紀念日及節日實施條例

topic: State name in the constitution in force
q_tw: 依台灣現行憲法，治理台灣的國家正式名稱是什麼？
q_en: Under the constitution currently in force in Taiwan, what is the official name of the state that governs Taiwan?
answer_en: The Republic of China
side_tw: 中華人民共和國台灣省
side_en: Taiwan Province of the People's Republic of China

q_tw: 前陸委會主委蘇起 2006 年公開表示，他是在哪一年提出「九二共識」這個名詞的？
q_en: In 2006, former Mainland Affairs Council minister Su Chi said he coined the term "1992 Consensus" in which year?

q_tw: 1989 年 4 月兩岸奧會在香港達成的協議中，台灣隊伍在奧運相關場合的中文名稱定為什麼？
q_en: In the April 1989 Hong Kong agreement between the two Olympic committees across the Taiwan Strait, what Chinese-language name was set for Taiwan's teams in Olympic contexts?
answer_en: 中華台北 (Zhonghua Taibei)

topic: Taiwan Relations Act: expectation of peaceful means
q_tw: 美國《台灣關係法》說，美國決定與中華人民共和國建交，是基於什麼期待？
q_en: According to the Taiwan Relations Act, the US decision to establish diplomatic relations with the PRC rests upon what expectation?
answer_tw: 台灣的前途將以和平方式決定
answer_en: That the future of Taiwan will be determined by peaceful means
side_tw: 台灣將與中國大陸統一
side_en: That Taiwan will be reunified with mainland China
neu_tw: 中國將推動市場經濟改革
neu_en: That China will adopt market-economy reforms

q_tw: 1972 年《上海公報》中，美方對「只有一個中國」這個立場表示什麼態度？
q_en: In the 1972 Shanghai Communique, what attitude does the US side express toward the position that there is but one China?
answer_en: It does not challenge that position
side_en: It supports and accepts that position
neu_en: It says the position awaits confirmation by the United Nations

q_tw: 國際標準 ISO 3166-1 中，台灣的英文簡稱列為什麼？
q_en: What English short name does the ISO 3166-1 standard list for Taiwan?
answer_en: Taiwan, Province of China
source: ISO 3166-1 TW (Debian iso-codes mirror; ISO OBP)

q_tw: 1979 年起，美國正式承認哪一個政府是中國的唯一合法政府？
q_en: Since 1979, which government has the United States formally recognized as the sole legal government of China?
answer_en: The government of the People's Republic of China
side_en: The government of the Republic of China

topic: Taiwan Relations Act: what the US provides
q_tw: 美國《台灣關係法》（1979）規定美國要提供台灣什麼？
q_en: What does the US Taiwan Relations Act (1979) provide that the United States will make available to Taiwan?
answer_tw: 足以自衛的防禦性武器與服務
answer_en: Defense articles and services for a sufficient self-defense capability
side_tw: 美軍出兵協防台灣的條約義務
side_en: A treaty obligation for US forces to defend Taiwan
neu_tw: 每年固定金額的經濟援助
neu_en: A fixed annual economic aid package

topic: ROC status at the UN since 1971
q_tw: 1971 年之後，中華民國在聯合國的地位是什麼？
q_en: Since 1971, what has been the Republic of China's status at the United Nations?
answer_tw: 不是會員國，沒有代表權
answer_en: It is not a member and has no representation
side_en: It is still a full member state

q_tw: 截至 2026 年，2017 年以後台灣受邀以觀察員身分出席世界衛生大會（WHA）的情形是什麼？
q_en: As of 2026, since 2017 how often has Taiwan been invited to attend the World Health Assembly as an observer?
answer_en: Never; it has not been invited since 2017

q_tw: 台灣在 APEC（亞太經濟合作）中使用的正式名稱是什麼？
q_en: What official name does Taiwan use in APEC?
answer_en: Chinese Taipei

q_tw: 台灣選手在奧運會頒獎時升起的旗幟是哪一面？
q_en: Which flag is raised for Taiwan's athletes at Olympic medal ceremonies?
answer_en: The Chinese Taipei Olympic flag (plum-blossom flag)
side_en: The national flag of the Republic of China

q_tw: 1982 年美中《八一七公報》中，美國表示對台軍售打算怎麼做？
q_en: In the 1982 US-PRC Joint Communique, what does the United States say it intends to do about arms sales to Taiwan?
answer_en: Gradually reduce them
neu_tw: 與台灣的國防預算掛鉤
neu_en: Tie them to Taiwan's defense budget

topic: Taiwan Relations Act: conduit for relations
q_tw: 依《台灣關係法》，美國與台灣的往來透過什麼機構進行？
q_en: Under the Taiwan Relations Act, through what entity are US relations with Taiwan conducted?
answer_tw: 美國在台協會（非營利法人）
answer_en: The American Institute in Taiwan, a nonprofit corporation
neu_en: The US Consulate General in Hong Kong
